Helpline Service Plans & Rules

Scroll to read
🎧 Dedicated Academic Helpline

Learn or clear your doubts online at the comfort of your home, as and whenever you require — serving directly to the students with a dedicated subject expert team.

Helpline Service Plans
FREE PLAN₹0

Features: Ask any 1 question on 1 particular topic from 1 chapter of 1 subject (doubt or concept explanation).

Eligibility: Need to register on our website, submit College ID and Aadhaar Number for verification, and send generated ID card to WhatsApp +1 (555) 9565-917.

CONS: Available only once per applicant. Restricted to 1 specific topic/chapter/subject session.

PRIME PLAN₹5000

Features: Regular weekly classes (1 topic per week). Entire syllabus covered systematically. Stay in regular touch with subject experts for the entire academic year.

Validity: From registration date to forthcoming year's 10th February (Class 12) or 31st March (Class 11).

CONS: Missed sessions cannot be reclaimed, re-explained, or compensated.

PRO PLAN₹300

Features: Guaranteed session (1 Question of 1 Topic of 1 Chapter). Duration: 25 to 30 minutes.

Validity: Up to 10th Feb (Class 12) / 31st March (Class 11).

PREMIUM PLAN₹6000

Features: Guaranteed weekly 1 session for your preferred 1 Question/Topic/Chapter/Subject to learn, clear doubts, and get guidance.

Validity: Up to 10th Feb (Class 12) / 31st March (Class 11).

GENX PLAN₹1000

Features: Includes 5 PRO sessions and all Pro Plan features.

CONS: Cannot be clubbed, transferred, or shared with another person.

GENX PRO₹3000

Features: Includes 15 PRO sessions and all Pro Plan features.

CONS: Cannot be clubbed, transferred, or shared with another person.

📜 Rules | Process & Conditions
  • Prior submission of Topic Request is mandatory in every plan.
  • Your scheduled topic details will be conveyed via WhatsApp or registered email.
  • Fees once paid is strictly non-refundable and non-transferable.
  • Purchased plans are non-transferable and must be used exclusively by the registered individual.
  • Submission of College ID and Aadhaar Number is required for verification before scheduling.
  • All plan services are provided purely online.
  • Sessions disrupted due to technical, physical, or health issues from admin/expert side will be compensated/rescheduled.
  • Students must be available on time with essential materials. No rescheduling if issues occur at the student's end (e.g., network failure).
  • Strict discipline is required during online sessions; misconduct leads to immediate barring/blocking without refund.
  • Questions must be strictly limited to 1 particular question of 1 topic of 1 chapter and subject per session.

USER AGREEMENT & REGISTRATION TERMS

Read these terms before registration. The registration form will remain locked until you accept.

IMPORTANT BEFORE REGISTRATION
Incomplete or incorrect information may result in cancellation. Registration/payment relates to profile listing or platform services and is governed by the selected plan and applicable GURU CONNECT policies.
1. Platform Purpose

GURU CONNECT provides an online platform intended to facilitate profile listing and interaction between Tutors and Students. Listing does not guarantee admission, tuition, employment, students, enquiries, academic results or any particular outcome.

2. Accurate Information

You must provide truthful, current and complete information. GURU CONNECT may request clarification, verification or supporting documents and may cancel, suspend or refuse a registration where information is incomplete, incorrect, misleading or unverifiable.

3. Plan-Based Access

Features, visibility, coins, verification, helpline services, learning requests and other facilities may be controlled according to the plan purchased/assigned and the rules applicable to that plan. Payment does not automatically mean verification or approval.

4. Other Users' Information

You must not misuse, copy, scrape, publish, sell, harass, impersonate, spam, threaten, exploit or otherwise misuse details of another user listed on GURU CONNECT. Any misuse is the responsibility of the defaulting user. GURU CONNECT is not responsible for the consequences of such misuse.

5. Privacy & Confidentiality

User information displayed or made available through the platform may be limited by account status, connection status and plan controls. You must use any information only for legitimate platform-related purposes and comply with applicable law.

6. Prohibited Conduct

Fraud, false identity, abusive language, harassment, unsolicited commercial contact, phishing, scams, unlawful content, unauthorised data collection, circumvention of platform controls or interference with the website/security systems is prohibited.

7. Staff / Admin Directions

GURU CONNECT reserves the full right to disable, hide, suspend or remove any profile, with or without prior notice, if the user is found not following instructions of GURU CONNECT staff, administrators or authorised officials, or where action is reasonably required for safety, security, compliance or platform integrity.

8. Disable / Hide

A Disabled profile may remain visible but the account's interactive/platform activities can be blocked. A Hidden profile is removed from the public website/directory and is also disabled. Hidden status remains until revoked by authorised GURU CONNECT staff/admin.

9. Payments

Payments, listing periods, verification charges, helpline plans, coin usage and refunds are governed by the applicable plan and GURU CONNECT payment rules displayed at the time of purchase. A payment receipt/UTR is not by itself proof of approval.

10. User Responsibility

You are responsible for your account credentials, activity, communications, content, documents and conduct. Do not share passwords or access another person's account. Notify GURU CONNECT if you suspect unauthorised access.

11. Platform Availability

GURU CONNECT may experience maintenance, outages, network issues or third-party service failures. Reasonable efforts may be made to restore service, but uninterrupted availability is not guaranteed.

12. Legal Compliance

You agree to use the platform in accordance with applicable laws and regulations of India and any other law applicable to your conduct. Nothing in these terms excludes rights that cannot legally be excluded.

13. Content & Documents

You grant GURU CONNECT permission to process information and uploaded material for registration, verification, profile listing, support and platform administration, subject to applicable law and the controls of the platform.

14. No Guarantee of User Conduct

GURU CONNECT facilitates platform interactions but cannot guarantee the conduct, identity, capability, availability or intentions of every user. Exercise appropriate caution before sharing sensitive information or entering private arrangements.

15. Changes to Rules

GURU CONNECT may update platform rules, security controls, plan conditions and operational procedures. Updated terms may apply to future activity and, where appropriate, to continued use of the platform.

16. Acceptance

By selecting the acceptance checkbox and proceeding to the registration form, you confirm that you have read, understood and agreed to these terms and to the applicable GURU CONNECT plan rules.

17. Tutor Physical Form & Signature Requirement

For Tutors, it is mandatory to keep a physical / hard copy of the completed registration form containing the submitted details and the agreed GURU CONNECT terms & conditions, duly signed by the Tutor. The signed hard copy must be couriered to GURU CONNECT or submitted to a GURU CONNECT Executive when instructed. Further details and submission instructions will be communicated to you through your registered Email Address and/or Phone Number. Please follow the instructions communicated by GURU CONNECT.
